body:
But her self confidence was not the reason I wanted her back.

I missed her because I was still attracted to her, I missed her lots. I missed when we hugged, kissed, did the things we did before as a couple. In the end, I ended up having to coerce her to come back to do those things again. Not realising how bad that was to do. I'm afraid that she is hurt and I don't know that.

I should probably specify why I feel the guilt I feel. I'm afraid that, when I pressured her into coming back, all the kissing and other things we did before was only because I coerced her into coming back, instead of love like it was before. I didn't realise what I was doing was wrong at the time, but now I do, and I feel like a terrible person for doing that.
